review:
A garden mole on a 7x7 cluster grid with fruits, vegetables, flowers and butterflies. Before each spin, two random symbols become a React Pair – when they land next to each other, they turn wild.

Four to seven scatters give 8 to 14 free spins, where React Pair multipliers apply to the total win. Each spin is a little puzzle to watch. Up to 5,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
